title: This Obsidian plugin will rollover any incomplete ...

message.content:
This Obsidian plugin will rollover any incomplete todo items from the previous daily note (could be yesterday, or a week ago) to today. This is triggered automatically when a new daily note is created via the internal Daily notes plugin, or the Periodic Notes plugin., It can also be run as a command from the Command Palette

翻译

Here's the translation to Chinese:

**这个Obsidian插件会将前一个日记笔记中未完成的待办事项（可能是昨天，或一周前）滚动到今天。这在通过内部日记插件或周期性笔记插件创建新的日记笔记时自动触发。它也可以从命令面板作为命令运行。**

Breaking it down by segments:

| English | Chinese |
|---------|---------|
| This Obsidian plugin | 这个Obsidian插件 |
| will rollover | 会滚动/转移 |
| any incomplete todo items | 任何未完成的待办事项 |
| from the previous daily note | 从前一个日记笔记 |
| (could be yesterday, or a week ago) | （可能是昨天，或一周前） |
| to today | 到今天 |
| This is triggered automatically | 这会自动触发 |
| when a new daily note is created | 当创建新的日记笔记时 |
| via the internal Daily notes plugin | 通过内部日记插件 |
| or the Periodic Notes plugin | 或周期性笔记插件 |
| It can also be run as a command | 它也可以作为命令运行 |
| from the Command Palette | 从命令面板 |

**Alternative, more natural phrasing:**

"这个Obsidian插件会自动将前一篇日记中未完成的任务项（可能是昨天或一周前）转移到今天。当通过内部日记插件或周期性笔记插件创建新日记时，该功能会自动触发。你也可以从命令面板手动运行这个命令。"
